data.text: ADR-005 rejected a statSync per file for the fingerprint, but the measurement was of a cold walk on files just written: 11 ms of names against 34 with sizes at 10k. Warm, which is every call that matters, the whole scan is 5 ms. Adding size closed a real hole — 'git checkout .kadence/', which the corruption warning itself recommends, changes no file name and so did not invalidate the cache it needed to.
